title: Key stage 4 performance by parliamentary constituency
description: DfE key stage 4 (GCSE) measures for England by Westminster parliamentary constituency: Attainment 8, Progress 8, English and maths basics, EBacc entry and achievement, and subject-level entry rates.

files.note: Published verbatim from the 2024/25 release's "Download all data (ZIP)" bundle (https://explore-education-statistics.service.gov.uk/find-statistics/key-stage-4-performance/2024-25/explore). 7,516 rows x 180 columns. The file spans 2018/19 to 2024/25, but the constituencies change vintage partway through: 2018/19 to 2022/23 use the 533 pre-review seats (E14000530 upwards) and 2023/24 onwards use the 543 seats of the July 2024 review (E14001063 upwards). Only the two 2024-boundary years are compiled, since joining the earlier years would need the 2010-to-2024 crosswalk and would silently mix geographies. Rows repeat per geography_basis (Pupil residency and School location), which must be pinned; unlike the sibling local-authority-district file there are no disadvantage or FSM breakdown rows. Progress 8 is unpublished at revised stage for 2024/25 and appears as "z" for all 543 seats, so it parses to null; 2023/24 carries it.
